name: Mutagenic Gift
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 3/legendary alchemist 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components v, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 24 hours

DESCRIPTION

This extract is mixed with the rare poison of the crimson scorpion prepared in an incredibly exacting fashion, transforming an alchemist’s mutagen into a powerful tincture.

As long as you are under the effects of mutagenic gift, drinking a dose of your mutagen heals you of an amount of damage equal to your alchemist level + your Intelligence modifier. For the spell’s duration, you gain a +2 alchemical bonus on all saving throws.
